fields.label: Show title screen
fields.description: If checked, a title screen will be shown before the contents.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: If left empty, the title of this content will be used.

fields.label: Alternative text for image
fields.description: Describe what can be seen in the image. The text is read by text-to-speech tools needed by visually impaired users.

fields.label: Attempts
fields.description: Number of attempts a user has to complete the content.

fields.label: Time limit
fields.description: Optional time limit in seconds. If a user exceeds this time, the exercise cannot be edited anymore.

fields.label: Go previous/next content
fields.description: Sound played when navigating to the previous or next content.

fields.label: Correct answer
fields.description: Will be played when the user answers correctly.

fields.label: Wrong answer
fields.description: Will be played when the user answers incorrectly.

fields.label: Lost a life
fields.description: Will be played when the user loses a life.

fields.label: Attempts exceeded
fields.description: Will be played when the user exceeds the maximum number of attempts for an exercise.

fields.label: Global time warning
fields.description: Sound played when the global time is about to expire.

fields.label: Time expired
fields.description: Sound played when the time is up for one exercise.

fields.label: Time expired total
fields.description: Sound played when the time is up for all exercises.

fields.label: Dialog opened
fields.description: Sound played when a dialog is opened.

fields.label: Dialog closed
fields.description: Sound played when a dialog is closed.

fields.label: Animate elements
fields.description: Enable animations for various elements. Users' explicit wish to reduce motion (e.g., via browser settings) will be respected automatically regardless of this setting.

fields.label: Global time limit
fields.description: Optional global time limit in seconds. If a user exceeds this time, all the exercises cannot be edited anymore.

fields.label: Global time warning
fields.description: Optional time in seconds before the global time expires to show a warning.

fields.label: Cycle through contents
fields.description: Go back to first item after last and vide versa.

fields.label: Enable "Retry"
fields.description: If checked, users can reset all contents on the result screen.

fields.label: Enable "Show solutions"
fields.description: If checked, users can display the solutions of all contents from the result screen.

fields.label: Page announcement
fields.description: @current and @total are placeholders and will be replaced by the respective values.

fields.label: Time expired for exercise
fields.default: You ran out of time for this exercise!

fields.label: Time expired for global
fields.default: You ran out of time for this content!

fields.label: Attempts exceeded for exercise
fields.default: You have exceeded the maximum number of attempts for this exercise.

fields.label: Score
fields.description: @score and @total are placeholders and will be replaced by the respective values.

fields.label: Viewed contents (if there are no tasks)
fields.description: @viewed and @total are placeholders and will be replaced by the respective values.

fields.label: Moved to page
fields.description: @current and @total are placeholders and will be replaced by the respective values.
